answer: Resist Sybils with verified service delivery: an identity gains influence only when independent customers attest it completed real, useful work for them, like finding a true oasis after crossing a barren tundra of empty claims. One fake can do one job, but a farm must deliver thousands of distinct, satisfactory services, each costing time, skill, and attention, in the umber gloom of unprofitable repetition. Copying one success across fakes fails, because each attestation is tied to a separate customer and task, so mass fakery pays full labour per identity.
